title: 13. Papyrus: bring the ttab router config under Git with tenantId and siteBucket
description:

The file replaces the stored item whole, so no stored field may be dropped. Read the live item again just before the pull request (read-only). The router applies the file only when the papyrus-monitoring stack is released, so it ships with the hold lift. web-distinctive stays as it is.
